source_facts: A driver takes a passenger across an old bridge.
The bridge begins collapsing while the car is still on it.
They escape onto a maintenance platform.
cases.before_opening: He drives onto an old bridge with a passenger.
cases.after_opening: The bridge starts collapsing before he can turn around.

source_facts: A man tries to clear leaves from a garden party.
He picks up a leaf blower.
The blower sends the party decorations into the pool.
cases.before_opening: A man uses a leaf blower at a garden party.
cases.after_opening: The party was fine until he picked up the leaf blower.

source_facts: A woman finds a locked suitcase in her hallway.
A child opens it with a key hidden in a book.
Inside is the family photo album that was believed lost.
cases.before_opening: A woman finds a locked suitcase in her hallway.
cases.after_opening: That locked suitcase was hiding something the family thought was gone.

source_facts: A boy searches the neighborhood for his lost dog.
The dog hears the boy calling from across a street.
The dog runs back to him.
cases.before_opening: A boy looks for his lost dog around the neighborhood.
cases.after_opening: The dog heard his voice before the boy saw her.

source_facts: A teenager walks into a garage to confront another boy.
The other boy is waiting beside a damaged motorcycle.
The motorcycle owner arrives and interrupts them.
cases.before_opening: He walks into the garage to confront the other boy.
cases.after_opening: He picked the worst possible time to start this confrontation.

source_facts: A night guard finds fresh footprints through an empty museum.
The footprints stop at a locked gallery door.
A cat is discovered inside the gallery.
cases.before_opening: A night guard finds footprints in an empty museum.
cases.after_opening: Someone had been walking through an empty museum. Or so it looked.

source_facts: A mechanic presses a button to open a workshop door.
The button locks the door instead.
A delivery truck is now waiting outside.
cases.before_opening: A mechanic tries to open the workshop door with a button.
cases.after_opening: That button was meant to open the door. It did the opposite.
